title: Add checks field to GET /api/codex/ready
description: Extend the existing `GET /api/codex/ready` endpoint to include a `checks` field. The field must be an object mapping each subsystem name (e.g. `store`, `event_bus`, `process_manager`) to a JSON object with `ok` (boolean) and `detail` (string or null) describing the subsystem's state. Subsystems that are unavailable must have `ok: false` and a `detail` string explaining why; subsystems that are healthy must have `ok: true` and `detail: null`.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/codex/ready response includes a top-level `checks` field
checks is a dict keyed by subsystem name
Each subsystem entry has `ok` (boolean) and `detail` (string or null) fields

pinned_qa_commands.command: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -c "import urllib.request, json; r = urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:9000/api/codex/ready'); body = json.loads(r.read()); assert r.status in (200, 503); assert isinstance(body.get('checks'), dict); assert all('ok' in v and 'detail' in v for v in body['checks'].values())"
pinned_qa_commands.description: Fetch /api/codex/ready and assert the checks field shape
